$comment: RFC 0169 §A.2/§B.3 — supported: string[] becomes providers[]; imageGeneration/videoGeneration are facets

policies.description: Optional v1 host-side policy enforcement modes for per-provider gating. Omitted → no enforcement; clients see only `optional` semantics. When present, MUST declare `modes` — an empty `{}` is not a valid third state. See `capabilities.md` §`aiProviders.policies`. **Restored 2026-09-19:** the v2 override had reduced this to `{type: object, additionalProperties: true}` — an open object with no properties, no enum and no description — so anything validated, including a misspelled member. It was one of only TWO such facets in the whole v2 schema. MyndHyve's live major-2 document already advertises exactly the v1 shape, so restoring the constraint rejects nothing published and makes a typo fail instead of ship.

modes.description: Subset of policy modes this host can enforce. `disabled` = provider may not be used; `optional` = no restriction (default); `required` = BYOK required; `restricted` = model must match the policy's `allowedModels` glob list. Hosts MAY support a subset; clients MUST tolerate any subset.

scopes.description: Resolution layers the host evaluates. Conventional ids: `workspace`, `project`, `canvas-type`. Precedence is host-defined and SHOULD be documented per-deployment.

errorCode.description: Wire-format error code returned on denial. Defaults to `provider_policy_denied`. Reserved for hosts that need a vendor-prefixed alias.

input.description: RFC 0091. Multimodal PERCEPTION input on `ctx.callAI` — the modalities a `callAI` message ContentPart may carry as model INPUT. Absent ⇒ text-only (today's behavior); a `string` message content is always valid. Distinct from `imageGeneration` (output) and the `ai-envelope.md` media emission types (output). **Restored 2026-09-19:** the v2 override had reduced this to `{type: object, additionalProperties: true}` — an open object with no properties, no enum and no description — so anything validated, including a misspelled member. It was one of only TWO such facets in the whole v2 schema. MyndHyve's live major-2 document already advertises exactly the v1 shape, so restoring the constraint rejects nothing published and makes a typo fail instead of ship.

modalities.description: Input modalities the host's `callAI` accepts as ContentParts. `text` is implicit even when omitted. A ContentPart whose `type` is not advertised here MUST be rejected with `unsupported_modality` (never silently dropped).

maxBytesPerPart.description: Optional host cap on a single inline (`data`) or `mediaRef` part.
